notes: The browser read the whole MVA organizational list (777 entries on 44 pages, images all re-uploaded June 2026) and the military/veteran gallery (75 entries); motorcycle-only versions skipped. The 87 org 'new' entries are mostly long-standing plates that the 2023 snapshot missed, so year is null; 20 of them show only MVA's 'Tag Coming Soon' placeholder (source_img null), which may mean they are newly approved (MAGFest, Teacher of the Year, UMGC, Washington Redskins Charitable Foundation still listed under that name). New Veteran-branch plates (Army, Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, Coast Guard) have 2026-04 images; the game already has Veteran US Space Force. matches_existing flags two likely renames (UMGC was UMUC; Piscataway Conoy Tribe may or may not be the same group as the Confederacy). 'Retired' = 126 game org plates absent from the full org list; existing plates may still be on the road. I did not retire military medal plates: the MVA military gallery omits statutory ones like Purple Heart and Bronze Star, so it is not a full list. Left alone as near-duplicates rather than retired: Loyola College Alumni (now Loyola University Maryland), Westie Rescue (Maryland Westie Rescue), Honorably Discharged Veteran (likely replaced by branch Veteran plates), FOP Associate Members, UMES Alumni ('Maryland's Eastern Shore'), UM Medical Center, UM Cooperative Extension, MSPE - Licensed.
